statement_record.book: For a two-variable diagram F : I x J -> C, if the iterated limits lim_I lim_J F and lim_J lim_I F exist then they are isomorphic to each other and both compute lim_{I x J} F: limits commute with limits (dually, colimits commute with colimits).
